exposure: attendance at an education program for pregnant women
cohort: 520 primiparous women in four hospitals in southern Spain in 2011
finding: Attending an education program for pregnant women was associated with increased establishment of early skin-to-skin contact and greater maternal participation during delivery, but did not influence the type of delivery or duration.
mod_finding: Maternal education did not have a significant association with the type of delivery, including the frequency of cesarean section.
